d: The job holder will be integral part of the finance team providing clear, accurate and insightful business/financial analysis. They job holder will also contribute to business planning and be included in project work and or specialist ad hoc reporting.
Build an understanding of the value drivers of the business
Create analytics around key performance indicators to facilitate qualitative reporting. These may include:
o Cash flow and working capital
Provide clear analysis to incorporate within the monthly reports designed to allow management to understand key continuing and developing trends
Provide support in the business planning and forecasting processes
Liaise with business managers in areas of expertise and through confident and clear communication develop a trusted partner status through high quality support and decision aiding analysis
CA/CPA/CMA/MBA or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
1-3 years of post-qualification professional experience within finance
Strong analytical skills; should be capable of identifying and interpreting key business drivers.

Self-starter, able to work across functions and in teams. Results-driven, with the ability to perform on unstructured assignments

SAON Logistic is a Saudi company specializing in integrated logistics services, offering advanced warehouses with smart management systems and modern technologies. The company focuses on meeting diverse storage needs through innovative solutions that prioritize safety, flexibility, and efficiency in handling products. Goods are stored in an organized way to ensure easy access, accurate management, and strong inventory control. SAON Logistic supports both specialized and general storage environments, providing tailored solutions to protect product integrity and maintain high safety standards. The company is committed to delivering reliable, customer-focused logistics services across the Kingdom.

The Sales Employee (موظف مبيعات) will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, promoting SAON Logistic’s warehousing and logistics services, and building strong relationships with current and potential clients. Daily tasks include conducting client visits, preparing proposals and quotations, following up on leads, negotiating terms, and supporting clients through the sales process.
The role also involves coordinating with operations and customer service teams to ensure that client needs are clearly communicated and met, and maintaining accurate sales records and reports.
This is a full-time, on-site role based in Riyadh, requiring active engagement with the local market and regular in-person meetings with customers.
Minimum 6 years of professional sales experience is required , preferably in logistics, warehousing, supply chain, or B2B services.
Strong sales and negotiation skills, with the ability to identify customer needs and present suitable logistics solutions.
Proven ability to generate leads, acquire new clients, and achieve sales targets.
Customer relationship management skills, including effective communication, follow-up, and client retention.
Good understanding of logistics, warehousing, and supply chain concepts.
Proficiency in using CRM systems, office software, and digital tools for preparing proposals, reports, and client documentation.
Fluency in Arabic; good command of English is an advantage.
Ability to work on-site in Riyadh, manage time effectively, and handle multiple client accounts simultaneously.
Relevant diploma or bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Logistics, or a related discipline is preferred.
